findings.desc: concept-cleanup: .lattice/story/actives/B-137a/plan.md:39,51,81 still preserves retired concepts. Line 39 presents agy as retaining a ManagedHostRun launcher contract although packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1633-1637 refuses agy before spawn. Lines 51 and 81 require legacy_unmanaged plus admission_managed/admission_unmanaged classifications, while docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:128-137 and packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:443-448 define managed/admission_only/adapter_only/readiness_probe/legacy_unmanaged and explicitly state admission_managed is not a status. The authoritative implementation plan can therefore misdirect later implementation and review. Canonical reports were read without promoting advisory evidence: acceptance_topology_check=observe/inconclusive/partial/legacy_missing/blocking=false; pre_review_check_read=observe/inconclusive/blocking=false; acceptance_rollout_report_read=observe/fail/AR_REPORT_STALE/receipt=stale/quorum=full-3x2/blocking=false; acceptance_rollout_check reports the same nonblocking stale rollout state.
